profile.headline: iOS Developer | Full Stack Developer | Customer-centric Developer | Discovering how to make a good DIGITAL environment for the next generation
profile.summary:
I am a customer-centric developer interested in making a better digital environment with experience designing and developing an iPad application, PDF annotating/note-taking application, from scratch to distribution with Agile (Scrum, Kanban). Understanding and reacting to customer feedback has significantly impacted product ratings, and Apple selected the application to display at Apple offline stores worldwide in 2019. Expanded skills to web development and working at InBody USA.

iOS: Swift, C++, UIKit, Xcode, Cocoa Touch, Core Data, TestFlight, PDF SDK (Pdfium, PSPDFKit)
Front-end: JavaScript, jQuery HTML5, CSS
Back-end: C#, ASP.NET, PHP, MSSQL, MySQL
Others:  Git & Github, Sourcetree, Bitbucket

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Developed an iPad app for user registration by QR scanning and SMS authentication to measure their body composition with the InBody Body Composition device
• Communicated with a headquarter development team in South Korea to add new features and fix issues of the LookinBody website for users from the USA, Canada, and Mexico
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET MVC · C# · Swift (Programming Language) · HTML5 · UIKit · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Microsoft SQL Server · Xcode

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Created an iOS graph module considering memory and performance to enable zooming/scrolling even more than ten years of data on changes in body composition of the user in the InBody iOS App
• Interoperated between Objective-C and Swift for InBody iOS App
• Enhanced the LookinBody website by adding new features and fixing issues from users all over the world
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET MVC · C# · Swift (Programming Language) · HTML5 · UIKit · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Microsoft SQL Server · Xcode

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Startup company with 10+ employees consulting to launch tech startup companies with the development of their product and training programming languages to potential programmers. 

• Assisted in developing the user account system of the Vada Partners website  
• Deployed the responsive prototype website; a social platform for pet owners
• Documented guidance to deploy the website for the students of the Bootcamp operated by Wcoding

Used Skills: React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Firebase, HTML, CSS, Sass, GitLab, AWS, EC2, RDS, Docker, PHP

positions.title: Co-Founder | iOS Developer
positions.description:
Startup company with 10+ employees providing the study toolkit that enables annotating PDF/note-taking. The iPad application that I developed was selected by Apple and displayed at Apple offline stores worldwide.

• Devised algorithms of user-oriented features like pen gestures and palm rejection engine have resulted in high product ratings in Apple App Store worldwide (overall rating 4.5+/5.0)
• Enhanced the performance of loading and rendering PDF pages by 200% by reducing steps of converting between normalized and denormalized pen data to improve user responsiveness
• Managed source codes and certificates to release every updated version of the product by Bitbucket and Apple App Store Connect
• Solved the product issues by interacting with users via face-to-face or remotely online, prioritizing future functions based on user feedback from all over the world by email or Apple App Store actively

Used Skills: Swift, UIKit, Xcode, Cocoa Touch, Core Data, Apple App Store Connect, TestFlight, Firebase, PSPDFKit, Pdfium(C++)

projects.title: Vada Partners
projects.description:
Used Skills: HTML, CSS, SASS, JavaScript, React.js, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Firebase, GitLab

Overview
• This project is developing an online interface for patent value estimation for a major intellectual property firm.

Responsibilities
• Developed Admin website - admin account 
• Developed handling user account - sign-up / sign-in / find-password
• Developed handling simple reports - create / view list
• Developed loading animation page

projects.title: MyReads
projects.description:
Used Skills: React.js

Overview
• This is the final assessment project for Udacity's React Fundamentals course. 

Goal
• Load Books by API
• Search Books with a keyword by API
• Change a category of the book to another category

What I learned
• Props & State
• PropTypes
• Class component & Functional component
• Controlled Components by searching books and selecting a category
• Lifecycle Events
•• Initial loading books with componentDidMount
•• Update state by new props with getDerivedStateFromProps
•• No re-render the same components with shouldComponentUpdate
• Render loading screen with State
• Routing between the main page and the search page (SPA)
• Debounce/Throttle when typing the keyword on the text input for searching books
